usedFor: Shopify holds products and orders, and Pennylane receives each new product through “Create a Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create a Product” in Pennylane
bestTemplate.why: A product listed in the shop is also entered in Pennylane, so you type it once.

watchOut: “Create Customer” in Pennylane adds an individual customer only, so check a business buyer fits before using it.
